name: Conscientious Objectors
overview: Scripture reveals that ultimate authority and peace belong to Christ, the Prince of Peace, who will one day end all war and violence by transforming weapons into tools for peace. Jesus teaches His followers to resist evil without retaliation, exemplified by turning the other cheek and rejecting the use of the sword. Even soldiers are instructed to avoid violence and live contentedly, highlighting a call to conscientious living that honors God’s kingdom rather than worldly conflict. While wars and rumors of wars will occur, believers are reminded not to be troubled, trusting in God's sovereign plan.
